description: This Java source file defines an Android Service named AlarmService_Service that handles alarm-triggered actions, shows notifications, and manages background work in a separate thread.

classes.name: AlarmService_Service
classes.description: An Android Service that responds to an alarm, displays notifications, and performs background tasks.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the notification manager, shows a notification, and starts a background thread.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cancels the notification and displays a toast indicating the service has stopped.

methods.name: mTask (Runnable)
methods.description: Performs dummy work by sleeping for 15 seconds, then stops the service.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns an IBinder for client interactions.

methods.name: showNotification
methods.description: Constructs and displays a notification indicating the service is running.
